title: FluxyLogger: open-source modular Arduino datalogger for environmental monitoring and cave air tracing
description:
FluxyLogger is an open-source modular datalogger platform based on Arduino UNO for environmental monitoring, originally developed for cave air tracing studies (speleology).

The same firmware supports several hardware configurations: NASO (MQ-2 gas sensor for air tracing and gas detection), NASO+LCD (with a 16x2 I2C display), METEO (BMP280 pressure/temperature sensor and anemometer) and VOC (SGP40/SGP30 air quality sensors). Data are logged as CSV files on a microSD card with RTC timestamps, and the device is configured through a USB serial console.

The repository contains the Arduino firmware, wiring schematics, assembly guides and user manuals (Italian and English), enclosure drawings and a web-based data viewer.
